dev.description: Runs the server and restarts it on changes. `--project-origin .` keeps watchexec from reading the main checkout's .gitignore, which ignores the worktrees; `--wrap-process none` lets turbo stop the server with watchexec

build.description: Builds the server after the web app, which it embeds. Cargo caches the build itself

check.description: Lints the server with Clippy. Not cached: the SQLx macros check the queries against the database

test.description: Runs the server's tests. Not cached: they run against the database
